NewsArticle.Title: Upgrade
NewsArticle.Content: 14:24 - 15:06, Dark Ages servers upgrade to welcome its fast-growing community. There may be a few unannounced resets in the next couple of days as upgrades are completed on all servers. Please report abnormal software behavior: [www.darkages.com/contact](http://www.darkages.com/contact) Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
